claims.scope: Every finite centered Boolean state on the uniform cube, with the source definitions F=H-P and J=sum q_i; every K>2.
claims.statement: For a physical pair {i,j}, Delta F <= H(X_i,X_j)-W_ij. Querying a current-source pair whenever H_ij-W_ij < K(q_i+q_j+C_ij) yields a finite physical restriction tree with F(root)-E F(leaves) < K(J(root)-E J(leaves)). Every terminal leaf satisfies I(X_i;X_j)+W_ij+K C_ij <= sigma_i(K)+sigma_j(K) for every remaining pair, and hence every matching spends pair mutual information at most once against the matched vertex surpluses.

dependencies.result: Exact physical block drift identities Delta_A F <= B_A-W_A and D_A=I_A+C_A; ratio-critical physical descendant theorem.
Sections 2-4 exact genuine-coordinate conditional recursion, used only to serialize a pair block with actual child recomputation; obsolete Section 5 candidate not used.

claims.scope: Terminal leaves of PAIR-PHYSICAL-STOPPING-NONREUSE-v1, and in particular genuine minimum-dimensional ratio-critical cores.
claims.statement: With r_tilde_ij=P(i,j in X)-q_i q_j, I(X_i;X_j) >= (8/ln2) r_tilde_ij^2. Therefore every terminal matching M obeys sum_M r_tilde_ij^2 <= (ln2/8) sum_{v in V(M)} sigma_v(K). The centered variable is exactly zero for cross-factor pairs of an exact tensor despite positive raw orientation overlap.

dependencies.result: Exact r_ij=p_ij/4+o_ij identity and cross-factor tensor relation r_ij=q_i q_j.

claims.scope: A genuine centered minimum-dimensional ratio-critical core with rho=F/J>4; relative-1/16 robust derivative rows and their actual trigger coordinates.
claims.statement: For every robust row i and trigger k in F_i, r_tilde_ik > (13/48) q_i and I(X_i;X_k) > [169/(288 ln 2)] q_i^2 = 0.846581464966093... q_i^2. Hence every vertex-disjoint oriented robust-trigger matching M satisfies [169/(288 ln2)] sum_{(i,k) in M}q_i^2 < sum_M I_ik <= sum_{v in V(M)} sigma_v(4).

On a rho>4 critical core every active q_k<1/6.
